title: A Three-Month Review of a Language Learning App
passage:
LinguaStep (language learning app)
Rating: 3 out of 5 stars
Posted by Kenta_M on May 12

I downloaded LinguaStep three months ago because I wanted to improve my English before a school trip to Australia. The app is free, though a paid plan called Plus costs 600 yen a month.

The best thing is the daily five-minute lesson. Each lesson has ten short questions, and the app remembers the words I get wrong and shows them again a few days later. I think this system is the smartest part of the whole app. Since February I have finished 68 lessons and learned about 400 new words. My reading speed has clearly improved.

However, I have two complaints. First, the free plan gives you only three hearts. If you make three mistakes, you must wait six hours or watch an advertisement before you continue. This rule made me stop studying on days when I was tired. Second, the app almost never asks you to speak. There is a recording exercise, but it appears only in the Plus plan, and even then it sometimes accepts a wrong pronunciation.

Would I recommend it? Yes, but with a warning. LinguaStep is great for building vocabulary, and it fits easily into a busy day. For speaking, though, you will still need a teacher or a partner. I will keep using the free plan until the summer holidays, and then I will decide whether the Plus plan is worth the money.
